page_title: CAD 1-0 GET | Cadiz CF v Getafe 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
90+3' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sees a yellow card from Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+3' Luis Milla (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The players claim that Carles Alena (Getafe) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
89' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
86' Omar Alderete (Getafe) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
83' Flag up against Iza Carcelen (Cadiz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
82' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to make a change. Lucas Pires (Cadiz) replaces Robert Navarro.
81' The substitution is prepared. Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nemanja Maksimovic.

78' Juanmi (Cadiz) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul.
76' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
75' Getafe quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
75' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
73' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle.
73' The attendance is 16592.
71' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
69' Substitution. Chris Ramos did his best and is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
69' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
67' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
66' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

65' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
64' That's the end of the game for Joseba Zaldua, who is replaced by Iza Carcelen (Cadiz).
64' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Roger Marti and he is replaced by Juanmi (Cadiz).
63' Substitution. Ruben Sobrino makes way for Ivan Alejo (Cadiz).
61' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea ignores the protests.
61' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
60' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fali (Cadiz).
58' Here is a change. Jaime Mata is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
58' Substitution. Carles Alena (Getafe) replaces Yellu Santiago.
58' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
57' A yellow card for a tackle by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
54' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle after Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
52' The linesman raises his flag. Roger Marti (Cadiz) is adjudged offside.
50' Wasted opportunity! Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
48' Victor Chust (Cadiz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
47' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Omar Alderete (Getafe).
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Fabrizio Angileri is replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omar Alderete (Getafe) replaces Djene.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+1' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. Roger Marti (Cadiz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
42' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
39' The foul by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea.
35' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper David Soria no chance!
34' Today's referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea rightly decides to book Djene (Getafe) for his harsh tackle.
34' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
34' Rough tackle by Djene (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY AWARDED to Cadiz CF!
32' The referee blows for a cooling break.
31' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.

29' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but David Soria is alert and denies him with a nice save. Cadiz CF force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
25' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
23' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
22' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
21' Looks like Djene (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Roger Marti (Cadiz), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
19' Diego Rico (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
18' A pass lands at the feet of Robert Navarro (Cadiz) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
16' Jaime Mata (Getafe) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
15' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
14' Roger Marti (Cadiz) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
13' Roger Marti (Cadiz) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
12' Jaime Mata (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
10' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Roger Marti (Cadiz), but the defence gets it clear.
6' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' The ball is cleared after Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Roger Marti (Cadiz) is furious with himself. He collects a rebound near the penalty spot, and powers a header narrowly over the bar!
3' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Cadiz CF will take the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
